review_candidates.description: SENIOR DATA & BUSINESS SYSTEMS ANALYST Solé Farms | Remote, based in Medellín, Colombia | Independent contractor (prestación de servicios), paid in COP "Creating solutions that made other people in the company happy, productive and more efficient." The person who held this role before you said that was what he liked most about the job. That is the job. POSITION SUMMARY We want a versatile technology professional, not a single-tool specialist: someone fluent in our Business Intelligence (BI) and automation platforms who starts from the business problem and gets real satisfaction from making other people's work easier. The role starts with the technology. You will inherit a portfolio people already rely on: Power BI reports and data models, Azure automations and integrations, and the pipelines behind them. Keep them running, make them better, and learn the business through them. Everything we do is cloud-based and our IT department is very small, so there are no specialists to hand things to; you will need to be, or quickly become, knowledgeable across virtually everything we run. As you learn the business, the role grows toward process: working with sales, operations, logistics, purchasing and finance to find where work is slow, manual or error-prone, and building or bringing in the right solution. Someone who does this well can grow this engagement into leading business systems and technology work for Solé Farms. ABOUT SOLÉ FARMS Solé Farms is a rapidly growing, Miami-based importer, wholesaler and distributor of fresh cut flowers serving the United States and Canada, working directly with leading farms in Colombia, Ecuador and other growing regions. We are a technology-driven company: when perishable products cross borders every day, small process improvements add up quickly. WHAT YOU WILL DO From day one: Keep the data foundation reliable: pipelines, integrations, SQL, our Azure data environment and Snowflake warehouse. Own the existing portfolio: keep it running, document it, train its users, track the impact. Automate repetitive work with workflows, notifications and integrations between Komet, Sage Intacct, Snowflake and Azure. Give sales, operations and leadership the reports and analysis they rely on, and resolve discrepancies so people trust the numbers. As you learn the business: Sit with the people doing the work to map how a process really runs, quantify what manual effort costs, then define, implement and measure the improvement. Evaluate options honestly (a feature we already own, an off-the-shelf tool, a low-code or AI-assisted solution, or custom development) and recommend the best fit. When our current tools are not the right answer, say so. WHAT WE NEED Hands-on proficiency in our core stack: SQL and T-SQL; Power BI with DAX and data modeling; Azure Logic Apps and Functions; Azure Data Factory and/or Synapse Analytics; Python; REST APIs; Git and Azure DevOps. Proficient, not certified expert. Working knowledge across the technologies a cloud-based company runs on: Microsoft 365, cloud services, SaaS business applications, databases, integrations, automation and reporting. Experience analyzing business processes and designing solutions; build-versus-buy judgment; a working understanding of order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, inventory and logistics. Professional spoken and written English. This posting is a fair sample of what the role requires. A bachelor's degree in a related field and at least 5 years of relevant experience. Nice to have: Snowflake; mid-market accounting systems; Komet or another industry order-management platform; distribution or perishables experience; remote contractor work with US-based teams; practical use of AI-assisted tools. HOW WE WORK Part of the team, not an isolated ticket-taker. You will have a seat in our operations and sales meetings and make occasional trips to Miami, with travel costs covered by Solé Farms. You will be judged on whether people's work got better, not on tool mastery. Remote, with real flexibility. We do not prescribe working hours; we ask that you be available to the team in Miami during agreed-upon periods and for all scheduled meetings, set on Miami (US Eastern) time. Contract basics. Independent contractor engagement, initial term 12 months, renewable. Fees invoiced twice a month. The fee is the full amount we pay you; out of it you make your own monthly contributions for health (EPS), pension (AFP) and occupational risk insurance (ARL), as Colombian law requires. Monthly fee: from COP 12 million, depending on experience, plus a quarterly bonus based on performance. HOW TO APPLY Apply through this posting. Be ready to tell us about one solution you built that people thanked you for… It will be our first interview question. Full description (PDF): https://solefarms.sharepoint.com/:b:/s/JobPostsandIndependentContractorOpportunities/IQDAEfihITLiSbUAqmVp6PJ7AXhnkdl5PutgpM4W2JyOKnc?e=sPqqO4 Solé Farms welcomes applicants of all backgrounds.

review_candidates.title: Marketing Operations, Data & Events Coordinator
review_candidates.description: About the job Marketing Operations, Data & Events Coordinator Learning Genie Inc. | 100% Remote (LATAM & Philippines) | Full-Time | Operations & Marketing Are You Ready to Drive Operational Excellence and Marketing Growth? Learning Genie Inc. is a fast-growing, award-winning EdTech startup headquartered in Carlsbad, California — recognized by ABC 10 News, the San Diego Business Journal, and proud winners of the Tech & Learning Best of Show Award! We're on a mission to transform early childhood education through AI-powered solutions. To support our rapid scaling, we're looking for a highly organized, proactive professional to serve as the execution backbone for our marketing and events pipelines. The Opportunity As our Marketing Operations & Events Coordinator, you'll be the execution backbone for our marketing and events pipelines: conference logistics, sponsorships, campaigns, and data tracking. This role is built for someone exceptionally organized, detail-obsessed, and proactive — whether you come from a marketing background or a strong administrative/events-coordination background, a genuine curiosity for how marketing actually works and a habit of learning fast are what matter most. Operating 100% remotely from Latin America or the Philippines, you'll work directly with our CEO and Marketing team to make sure everything — from conference selection and execution, to campaign support and post-event lead conversion — runs flawlessly. What You'll Be Doing Assist with contract management, vendor invoice tracking, purchase requests, and daily bookkeeping using Excel and QuickBooks Online Support the planning and execution of conferences, trade shows, webinars, and other events — timelines, budgets, deliverables, registrations, travel, booth logistics, and shipment/inventory of event materials, plus onsite/virtual execution when needed Review sponsorship agreements, track deliverables (ads, social posts, speaking slots, exhibit tables) to confirm we receive every contracted benefit, and keep organized records of packages, invoices, and contacts Research conferences, associations, and sponsorship opportunities relevant to school districts, education organizations, and industry stakeholders; help evaluate which are worth attending based on relevance, cost, and expected return, and prepare clear recommendations for leadership Maintain accurate conference, sponsorship, contact, and budget trackers in Google Workspace and HubSpot CRM; clean and deduplicate data to keep it reliable Track registrations, leads, and post-event outcomes; support reporting on event performance Assist with email campaigns, registration/RSVP forms, and routing hot leads to sales Post-event: distribute leads to the right team members, document notes in the appropriate systems, and compare results against goals to inform future participation decisions What Makes You the One 2+ years as an Executive Assistant, Operations Coordinator, Events Coordinator, or Marketing Coordinator (required) Based in LATAM or the Philippines, C1 English, available 8:00 AM–4:30 PM PST (required) Highly organized and detail-obsessed, comfortable juggling multiple priorities Proactive lifelong learner — solves problems before being asked, picks up new tools fast Strong Google Sheets skills, plus familiarity with QuickBooks Online, Zoom, and Excel Experience with or quick to adapt to HubSpot, monday.com, or similar CRMs Hands-on with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT) and comfortable using AI automations Marketing degree highly preferred (or equivalent know-how) — should understand the marketing funnel, B2B vs. B2C, and how to evaluate event/sponsorship ROI Nice to have: conference/event coordination experience, EdTech or education background, Mailchimp/Canva, Google Apps Script or AI workflow automation, experience with school districts or government-funded programs Why You'll Love Working Here Initial Salary: US $1,440/month (equivalent to $9.00/hour) during the 90-day training/probation period. After probation, salary can be revisited up to US $10–11/hour depending on performance 100% remote — work from anywhere in LATAM or the Philippines Standard work week, Monday–Friday (8:00 AM–4:30 PM Pacific Time) Real career growth at a fast-moving, award-winning EdTech startup Encouraged and expected to use cutting-edge AI tools to scale your workflows Work that creates genuine social impact for the education industry This Probably Isn't for You If… You prefer routine over a fast-paced, ever-evolving environment You're intimidated by learning new software, CRMs, or AI automation tools You wait to be handed tasks instead of proactively identifying bottlenecks and offering solutions You struggle to keep meticulous track of moving parts, deadlines, and data streams If you're a detail-obsessed operational powerhouse ready to support leadership and drive marketing success — we want to hear from you!
